test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 1 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

JKLO ∶ GHIL ∶∶ LJKM ∶ IGHJ ∶∶ DOUL ∶ ?
solution: The table showing the positional value of the alphabets is as follows [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf650c01d4e041b18cf1732a47c42f4c1415f2128aeef953723baf0cd6b18f46.png] **Given :- JKLO ∶ GHIL ∶∶ LJKM ∶ IGHJ ∶∶ DOUL ∶ ?** Here, the following logic is used **JKLO ∶ GHIL** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/208bded4a20cdb6c1cbdca1a63c391d2ae68c6770093ed18ef0b3b0486384f1b.png] ** LJKM ∶ IGHJ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f503c2f915c4d080150833aff737c8478372d32d68064204aa7ca24a35cfe331.png] **DOUL ∶ ?** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8cf14193b5d99b4563a37234c432c7e8e943ffd106831a05c62de3c6ebd282d.png] Therefore,** '?' **will be replaced by** 'ALRI'** Hence, the correct answer is **option(3).** 86:T8ac,
